module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 199

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/199](https://www.erdosproblems.com/199)
- [Ba75] Baumgartner, James E., *Partitioning vector spaces*. J. Combinatorial Theory
  Ser. A (1975), 231-233.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Erdos199

/--
If $A\subset \mathbb{R}$ does not contain a 3-term arithmetic progression then must $\mathbb{R}\backslash A$ contain an infinite arithmetic progression?

Baumgartner [Ba75] answered this in the negative.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5,
  formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/main/src/v4.29.1/ErdosProblems/Erdos199.lean"]
theorem erdos_199 : answer(False) ↔
    ∀ A : Set ℝ, ThreeAPFree A →
      ∃ S : Set ℝ, S.IsAPOfLength ⊤ ∧ S ⊆ Aᶜ := by
  sorry

end Erdos199

sources_consulted: https://www.erdosproblems.com/199 — read through its archived copy at http://web.archive.org/web/20260709213235id_/https://www.erdosproblems.com/199

Erdős, P. and Graham, R. L., Old and new problems and results in combinatorial number theory: van der Waerden's theorem and related topics, Enseign. Math. 25 (1979), 325–344, especially p. 339 and the Baumgartner reference on p. 340: https://users.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1979-07.pdf
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plby/lean-proofs/main/src/v4.29.1/ErdosProblems/Erdos199.lean — cited formal proof, including its predicates and final disproof
review.notes: The sole declaration, Erdos199.erdos_199, faithfully states the source's question with its established negative answer. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, proved that ThreeAPFree excludes exactly nontrivial three-term progressions, and that S.IsAPOfLength ⊤ is equivalent to S = {a + n*d | n : ℕ} with d ≠ 0. Checked empty sets, singletons, the whole real line, zero common difference, and small computable ThreeAPFree examples. Also proved equivalence with the cited formal proof's statement. A proof-only compatibility port of that Lean 4.29.1 proof to the available Lean 4.33.1 successfully proves the exact repository proposition with only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The solved category and answer(False) agree with the archived source and current public database. Baumgartner's publisher-hosted full text was inaccessible; the original Erdős–Graham paper independently confirms the question and unconditional negative solution. No declaration's faithfulness remains unresolved.
